qualification_review.interpretation: The press will learn about completion, conversion, audience reach, and the relationship between audio sampling and book sales during one season.
qualification_review.limitations: The pilot measurements cannot establish the economics or audience response of a full audiobook.

records.interpretation: The publisher begins interested in an audio experiment while protecting the autumn list from an open-ended production commitment.
records.limitations: This describes the starting business tension before the season charter is signed.

records.interpretation: The press adopts a six-episode season with a fixed budget, authority table, production bank, transcript and version controls, privacy limits, checkpoints, channel rules, and a dated board decision.
records.limitations: The charter approves one season and does not select a later publishing format.

records.interpretation: The audience measures are deliberately limited to aggregate behavior, voluntary feedback, and book-page or bundle activity during the pilot window.
records.limitations: Those measures may inform the October board choice but do not predict a different production scale.
